title: Field Signal mini-retrospective and action annotary (customer asks)
content:
Purpose: quick, tactical roll-up of the most actionable field signals from last 6 weeks. Not a canonical VOC artifact — this is a working note for eng + product to pick nimble patches.

Context and intake sources:
- Weekly CS triage (7/2, 7/9, 7/16) + account check-ins with 6 mid-market customers (Acme Health, VeloxChat, DataMuse, BrioLegal, MarketFold, StudyLane).
- Support threads flagged for SLA/latency spikes (internal label: latency-spike).
- Customer engineering syncs: recorded calls and short runbooks attached in linked_artifacts.

High level themes (ranked by frequency + business impact):
1) Latency variability at tail (esp. fine-tuned/custom models) — repeated ask: per-route latency ceilings and clearer fallbacks.
   - Customer quotes: "Occasional +500ms token stalls kill conversational UX, even if 95th is fine" (VeloxChat eng lead).
   - Root-cause signals: model variant routing toggling at busy hours; KV-cache cold-starts after scale events.
   - Quick ideas: expose "soft-latency" config per route -> automatically route to lower-cost/fast variant after 150ms single-token queue.
   - Rough cost/risk: medium dev effort (routing + per-route config UI), high customer confidence gain.
   - Proposed owner: Eng (serving-runtime) + Product (hosted-api). Owner: Liam O'Connor. Tentative milestone: POC in 3 sprints (8/16).

2) Token-cost visibility and attribution for hybrid flows (generation + rerank + embedding).
   - Customers running multi-step pipelines can't map spend to outcomes. Need per-step token & price attribution and simplified bill view.
   - Request from DataMuse: "Please show embedding calls and reranker costs as separate line-items in the invoice and console."
   - Quick ideas: add per-request breakdown on Console trace page + exportable CSV for invoices. Backend already emits token counts per subcall — surface layer only.
   - Risk: bookkeeping + billing edge cases for batched/async jobs. Small engineering effort but requires billing sign-off.
   - Proposed owner: Product (console) + Finance. Owner: Priya Sharma. Target: beta visibility 6 weeks (9/1).

3) Predictable Dedicated pool autoscale behavior and burst guarantees.
   - Enterprise customers want guardrails: "If traffic spikes we want guaranteed capacity or a predictable fallback (e.g., degraded model with same API surface)." (BrioLegal infra lead)
   - Notes: current Dedicated autoscaler is conservative; some customers configure manual buffers but find ops awkward.
   - Quick mitigation: offer a "burst reserve" toggle (percentage of pool kept as warm capacity) + documented SLO tradeoffs.
   - Proposed owner: Dedicated product + Platform Eng. Owner: Noah Martinez. Timeline: design + doc in 4 weeks.

4) Private deployment onboarding frictions: KMS/HSM key rotation & audit logs gaps.
   - Several customers on private pilot (Acme Health, MarketFold) reported incomplete guidance and one missed audit field (encryption key rotation timestamp not present in logs).
   - Action: update onboarding checklist, produce a short runbook for KMS integration, and add missing audit field in private agent.
   - Owner: Private Deployments eng + Security compliance. Owner: Maya Chen. Small patch; aim for 2-week release.

Low-effort, high-impact quick wins (<=2 dev-weeks):
- Console: Add a "last cache hit" timestamp to route trace views (helps identify KV-cache cold starts). Owner: console-and-rollouts.
- API: Add header X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason when a request was routed to a fallback model. Owner: hosted-api.
- Docs: Short how-to on designing prompt sets to reduce token drift across reranks. Owner: devx.

Feature requests (compilation, not prioritized):
- Fine-grained model fallback policies per customer (e.g., prefer cheaper variant unless latency > X).
- Route-level QoS: ability to mark critical routes that must not be batched beyond N requests.
- Persistent KV-cache across short-lived pods (reduce warm-starts for low-frequency bursts).
- Embedding dimensionality stability guarantees (customers want pinning to prevent upstream model changes altering vector sizes).
- Function call failure introspection: structure of partial outputs and deterministic retry semantics.

Customer vignettes (short):
- VeloxChat: tailoring affordances for chat — they need <20ms variability on first-token generation to keep typing indicator consistent; willing to pay premium for a latency-focused route.
- Acme Health: regulatory requirement to show KMS rotation audit entries; private deployment pilot stalled because of missing audit field.
- DataMuse: uses embeddings -> reranker -> generation pipeline. Lost trust because cost jumped 2.8x month-over-month due to unintended reranker replays (duplicate calls).

Open questions (we should resolve prior to next field sync):
- What SLAs can we promise for route-level latency ceilings without overcommitting? (SRE + Serving-runtime input required)
- Billing: how will per-step line-itemization interact with credits/committed usage? (Finance to confirm)
- Dedicated burst: can cloud infra vendors support warm GPUs at needed times without huge cost? (Platform to validate)

Next steps and meeting plan:
- This doc is a pre-read for CS <> Eng sync 7/29. Ask each owner to bring: short technical feasibility notes and one proposed acceptance criterion.
- Quick wins backlog created in GH (linked: gh:infra/runtime/batch-optimizations#78).
- Owners to add a 1-2 line summary into the shared tracker by 7/25.

Notes to self / CS shorthand: 
- Mark "latency" threads with tag latency-spike; escalate if >3 distinct accounts in 7 days.
- Keep an eye on reranker duplicate-call telemetry (signal: rerank-dup spike).

Annex: raw quotes excerpted from customer calls (redacted)
- "We saw one hour where the user experience regressed and churn risk spiked — all because a rerank call doubled in frequency during a retry storm." — Product PM, DataMuse
- "We need a checkbox: \"I accept degraded model if this saves latency\" — customer-request phrasing."

Bottom line: there are a few small instrumentation & console surfaces we can ship quickly that will relieve the majority of current friction. Parallel work on Dedicated burst guarantees and private KMS audit fields should be scoped as higher-touch but tractable.

TODO (owners):
- Liam: write a 1-pager for soft-latency route config + sketch routing flow (due 7/25).
- Priya: align with finance on billing exposure constraints and report back (due 7/28).
- Noah: propose dedicated burst UX options and engineering constraints (due 8/2).
- Maya: ship private-agent audit-field patch + onboarding doc (due 8/2).

Slack refs: #cs-field-signals, #product-hosted-api, #serving-runtime

-- end of mini-retro (Maya)
